entities.name: Minamoto no Yoshitomo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Minamoto no Yoshitomo  was a Japanese samurai and the head of the Minamoto clan and a general of the late Heian period of Japanese history. His son Minamoto no Yoritomo became shōgun and founded the Kamakura shogunate, the first shogunate in the history of Japan.
